description: This bar chart illustrates the macro f-score values for two models, RECA and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub>, across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The horizontal axis represents the frequency categories, labeled “High”, “Medium”, and “Low” in that order from left to right, and is categorical. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, labeled “Macro f-score”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1.  There are two bars for each frequency category, one orange representing RECA and one gray representing GAIT<sub>GAT</sub>. For the “High” frequency, the RECA bar has a value of approximately 0.837, while the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar has a value of approximately 0.877. For the “Medium” frequency, the RECA bar has a value of approximately 0.538, and the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar has a value of approximately 0.609. Finally, for the “Low” frequency, the RECA bar has a value of approximately 0.114, and the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar has a value of approximately 0.224. The bars are grouped by frequency category, with RECA and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bars positioned side-by-side within each category. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
